stem.en: Kabir attacks. Pick his best card.

text.en: "The live and boiled seeds have the same elements in the same amounts. If elements were the difference, one of them would be missing something."
"The seed has nitrogen and the flame does not, so nitrogen is the spark of life."

feedback.en: The boiled seed has just as much nitrogen and is dead. And the air the flame burns in is four-fifths nitrogen. An element that dead things also have cannot be the difference.

text.en: "The seed has metals in it, so the seed is a bit of a machine."

feedback.en: The oil has traces of metal too, and the boiled seed has exactly as much as the live one.

image.alt: A boy playing his best card in a duel over a notebook page showing the flame-and-seed elements ledger, a pinch of ash and salt on the table.
